mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_session_owners(tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,target_kind TEXT NOT NULL,target_id TEXT NOT NULL,session_id TEXT NOT NULL,end_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,subject_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_kind='USER'),subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_id=CAST(end_user_id AS TEXT)),PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,target_kind,target_id,session_id)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_sessions ( tenant_id text NOT NULL, session_id text NOT NULL, target_kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_id text NOT NULL, end_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, subject_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_kind='USER'), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_id=CAST(end_user_id AS TEXT)), last_event_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT execution_sessions_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,session_id), CONSTRAINT execution_sessions_owner_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id), CONSTRAINT execution_sessions_identity_ck CHECK (trim(tenant_id)<>'' AND trim(session_id)<>'' AND trim(target_id)<>'' AND end_user_id>0), CONSTRAINT execution_sessions_kind_ck CHECK (target_kind IN ('AGENT','TEAM')), CONSTRAINT execution_sessions_sequence_ck CHECK (last_event_sequence>=0) ) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_runs ( tenant_id text NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id text NOT NULL, target_kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_id text NOT NULL, end_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, subject_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_kind='USER'), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_id=CAST(end_user_id AS TEXT)), agent_id text NOT NULL, requester_kind TEXT NOT NULL,requester_end_user_id INTEGER,requester_system_principal_id TEXT, source_session_id TEXT,source_message_id TEXT,origin_ref TEXT NOT NULL, input_id TEXT NOT NULL, trace_id text NOT NULL, span_id text NOT NULL, root_input_id text NOT NULL, caused_by_event_id text, identity_ref text NOT NULL, actor_verification_ref text NOT NULL, configuration_ref text NOT NULL, input_ref text NOT NULL, initial_context_ref text NOT NULL, admission_fingerprint text NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, phase TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, fence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT false, decisions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tool_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, knowledge_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, context_ref text NOT NULL, current_action_id TEXT, waiting_action_id TEXT, waiting_generation INTEGER, batch_source_attempt text, batch_size integer, lease_worker_id text, lease_claim_id text, lease_until_second INTEGER, lease_until_nano integer, next_due_second INTEGER, next_due_nano integer, created_second INTEGER NOT NULL, created_nano integer NOT NULL, updated_second INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_nano integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT execution_runs_requester_ck CHECK (requester_kind='END_USER' AND requester_end_user_id=end_user_id AND requester_system_principal_id IS NULL), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_current_action_fk FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,current_action_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_actions(tenant_id,action_id,run_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT execution_runs_batch_source_fk FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,run_id,batch_source_attempt) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_attempts(tenant_id,run_id,attempt_id), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_session_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,run_id,session_id), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_full_owner_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,target_kind,target_id,agent_id,session_id,end_user_id,run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_input_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,input_id), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_owner_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_sessions(tenant_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_input_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,input_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_initial_context_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,initial_context_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_context_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,context_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_identity_ck CHECK (trim(run_id)<>'' AND trim(agent_id)<>'' AND trim(input_id)<>'' AND trim(trace_id)<>'' AND trim(span_id)<>'' AND trim(root_input_id)<>'' AND trim(identity_ref)<>'' AND trim(actor_verification_ref)<>'' AND trim(configuration_ref)<>'' AND trim(admission_fingerprint)<>''), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','SUSPENDED','RESUMING','COMPLETED','TERMINATED','FAILED','CANCELLED')), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_phase_ck CHECK (phase IN ('READY','AWAITING_RESULT','WAITING','UNCERTAIN','FINISHED') AND (phase='FINISHED')=(status IN ('COMPLETED','TERMINATED','FAILED','CANCELLED'))), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_counts_ck CHECK (revision>0 AND fence>=0 AND decisions>=0 AND tool_calls>=0 AND knowledge_calls>=0), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_lease_ck CHECK ((lease_claim_id IS NULL AND lease_worker_id IS NULL AND lease_until_second IS NULL AND lease_until_nano IS NULL) OR (lease_claim_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(lease_claim_id)<>'' AND lease_worker_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(lease_worker_id)<>'' AND fence>0 AND lease_until_second IS NOT NULL AND lease_until_nano IS NOT NULL AND lease_until_nano BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999)), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_terminal_lease_ck CHECK (phase NOT IN ('FINISHED','WAITING','UNCERTAIN') OR (lease_claim_id IS NULL AND next_due_second IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_due_ck CHECK ((next_due_second IS NULL AND next_due_nano IS NULL) OR (next_due_second IS NOT NULL AND next_due_nano IS NOT NULL AND next_due_nano BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999)), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_action_phase_ck CHECK ((phase<>'READY' OR current_action_id IS NULL OR waiting_action_id IS NOT NULL) AND (phase NOT IN ('AWAITING_RESULT','WAITING','UNCERTAIN') OR current_action_id IS NOT NULL OR batch_source_attempt IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_batch_ck CHECK ((batch_source_attempt IS NULL)=(batch_size IS NULL) AND (batch_source_attempt IS NULL OR (trim(batch_source_attempt)<>'' AND batch_size>=2 AND current_action_id IS NULL))), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_wait_ck CHECK ((waiting_action_id IS NULL)=(waiting_generation IS NULL) AND (waiting_generation IS NULL OR (waiting_generation>0 AND current_action_id=waiting_action_id)) AND (phase<>'WAITING' OR waiting_action_id IS NOT NULL OR batch_source_attempt IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT execution_runs_time_ck CHECK (created_nano BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999 AND updated_nano BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999 AND (updated_second,updated_nano)>=(created_second,created_nano)) ) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_actions ( tenant_id text NOT NULL, action_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, action_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_handle text NOT NULL, capability_ref text NOT NULL, request_ref text NOT NULL, fingerprint text NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, current_attempt text NOT NULL, selected_attempt text, batch_source_attempt text, batch_size integer, batch_slot integer, CONSTRAINT execution_actions_selected_fk FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,action_id,selected_attempt) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_attempts(tenant_id,action_id,attempt_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT execution_actions_current_fk FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,action_id,current_attempt) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_attempts(tenant_id,action_id,attempt_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT execution_actions_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,action_id), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_run_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,action_id,run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_ordinal_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,run_id,action_ordinal), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_batch_slot_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,run_id,batch_source_attempt,batch_slot), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_run_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_runs(tenant_id,run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_request_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,request_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_identity_ck CHECK (trim(action_id)<>'' AND action_ordinal>0 AND trim(target_handle)<>'' AND trim(capability_ref)<>'' AND trim(fingerprint)<>''), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_kind_ck CHECK (kind IN ('MODEL','TOOL','KNOWLEDGE','WORKFLOW','DELEGATION')), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_batch_ck CHECK ((batch_source_attempt IS NULL AND batch_size IS NULL AND batch_slot IS NULL) OR (batch_source_attempt IS NOT NULL AND trim(batch_source_attempt)<>'' AND batch_size IS NOT NULL AND batch_size>=2 AND batch_slot IS NOT NULL AND batch_slot BETWEEN 1 AND batch_size AND kind='TOOL')), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('DISPATCHED','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN','WAITING_INPUT')), CONSTRAINT execution_actions_selected_ck CHECK ((status NOT IN ('DISPATCHED','WAITING_INPUT') OR selected_attempt IS NULL) AND (status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') OR selected_attempt IS NOT NULL)) ) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_attempts ( tenant_id text NOT NULL, attempt_id text NOT NULL, action_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, fence INTEGER NOT NULL, request_ref text NOT NULL, fingerprint text NOT NULL, continuation_generation INTEGER, result_kind TEXT, result_ref text, uncertainty_ref text, feedback_ref text, external_operation text, adopted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT false, observation_sequence INTEGER, CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,attempt_id), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_action_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,action_id,attempt_id), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_run_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,run_id,attempt_id), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_action_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,action_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_actions(tenant_id,action_id,run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_request_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,request_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_result_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,result_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_uncertainty_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,uncertainty_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_feedback_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,feedback_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_budget_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,attempt_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_budget_attempts(tenant_id,attempt_id), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_identity_ck CHECK (trim(attempt_id)<>'' AND fence>0 AND trim(fingerprint)<>'' AND (continuation_generation IS NULL OR continuation_generation>0)), CONSTRAINT execution_attempts_result_ck CHECK ((result_kind IS NULL)=(result_ref IS NULL) AND (result_kind IS NULL OR result_kind IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN','INPUT_REQUIRED')) AND (NOT adopted OR result_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (feedback_ref IS NULL OR result_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (uncertainty_ref IS NULL OR result_ref IS NOT NULL)) ) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_batch_members ( tenant_id text NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL,source_attempt text NOT NULL,slot integer NOT NULL,size integer NOT NULL, action_id TEXT NOT NULL,first_attempt_id text NOT NULL,reused INTEGER NOT NULL,reused_result_ref text,reused_feedback_ref text, CONSTRAINT execution_batch_members_pk PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,run_id,source_attempt,slot), CONSTRAINT execution_batch_members_action_uq UNIQUE(tenant_id,run_id,source_attempt,action_id), CONSTRAINT execution_batch_members_source_fk FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,run_id,source_attempt) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_attempts(tenant_id,run_id,attempt_id), CONSTRAINT execution_batch_members_action_fk FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,action_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_actions(tenant_id,action_id,run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_batch_members_attempt_fk FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,action_id,first_attempt_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_attempts(tenant_id,action_id,attempt_id), CONSTRAINT execution_batch_members_result_fk FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,reused_result_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_batch_members_feedback_fk FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,reused_feedback_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_batch_members_slot_ck CHECK(size BETWEEN 2 AND 8 AND slot BETWEEN 1 AND size), CONSTRAINT execution_batch_members_reused_ck CHECK((reused AND reused_result_ref IS NOT NULL AND reused_feedback_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT reused AND reused_result_ref IS NULL AND reused_feedback_ref IS NULL)) ) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_waits ( tenant_id text NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, action_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_attempt text NOT NULL, input_id TEXT, response_ref text, fingerprint text, actor_ref text, accepted_revision INTEGER, continuation_attempt text, consumed_revision INTEGER, declared_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(declared_revision>0), business_wait_id text, execution_id text, suspend_ref text, action_key text, execution_revision INTEGER, plan_id text, plan_revision INTEGER, CONSTRAINT execution_waits_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,action_id,generation), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_run_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,run_id,action_id,generation), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_input_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,run_id,input_id), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_source_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,source_attempt), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_action_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,action_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_actions(tenant_id,action_id,run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_source_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,action_id,source_attempt) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_attempts(tenant_id,action_id,attempt_id), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_response_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,response_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_continuation_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,action_id,continuation_attempt) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_attempts(tenant_id,action_id,attempt_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT execution_waits_identity_ck CHECK (generation>0 AND trim(source_attempt)<>''), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_kind_ck CHECK (kind IN ('TOOL','HUMAN','DELEGATION','WORKFLOW','PLAN')), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_internal_ck CHECK ( (kind IN ('TOOL','HUMAN') AND business_wait_id IS NULL AND execution_id IS NULL AND suspend_ref IS NULL AND action_key IS NULL AND execution_revision IS NULL AND plan_id IS NULL AND plan_revision IS NULL) OR (kind='DELEGATION' AND business_wait_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(business_wait_id)<>'' AND execution_id IS NULL AND suspend_ref IS NULL AND action_key IS NULL AND execution_revision IS NULL AND plan_id IS NULL AND plan_revision IS NULL) OR (kind='WORKFLOW' AND business_wait_id IS NULL AND execution_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(execution_id)<>'' AND suspend_ref IS NOT NULL AND trim(suspend_ref)<>'' AND action_key IS NOT NULL AND trim(action_key)<>'' AND execution_revision IS NOT NULL AND execution_revision>0 AND plan_id IS NULL AND plan_revision IS NULL) OR (kind='PLAN' AND business_wait_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(business_wait_id)<>'' AND plan_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(plan_id)<>'' AND plan_revision IS NOT NULL AND plan_revision>0 AND execution_id IS NULL AND suspend_ref IS NULL AND action_key IS NULL AND execution_revision IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_accepted_ck CHECK ((input_id IS NULL AND response_ref IS NULL AND fingerprint IS NULL AND actor_ref IS NULL AND accepted_revision IS NULL) OR (input_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(input_id)<>'' AND response_ref IS NOT NULL AND fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND trim(fingerprint)<>'' AND actor_ref IS NOT NULL AND trim(actor_ref)<>'' AND accepted_revision IS NOT NULL AND accepted_revision>0)), CONSTRAINT execution_waits_consumed_ck CHECK ((continuation_attempt IS NULL OR (kind IN ('TOOL','WORKFLOW') AND input_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(continuation_attempt)<>'')) AND (consumed_revision IS NULL OR (kind IN ('HUMAN','DELEGATION','PLAN') AND input_id IS NOT NULL AND consumed_revision>accepted_revision))) ) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_wait_children ( tenant_id text NOT NULL, action_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, ordinal integer NOT NULL, delegation_id text NOT NULL, child_run_id TEXT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT execution_wait_children_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,action_id,generation,ordinal), CONSTRAINT execution_wait_children_entry_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,action_id,generation,delegation_id), CONSTRAINT execution_wait_children_run_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,action_id,generation,child_run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_wait_children_wait_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,action_id,generation) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_waits(tenant_id,action_id,generation), CONSTRAINT execution_wait_children_run_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,child_run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_runs(tenant_id,run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_wait_children_identity_ck CHECK (ordinal>0 AND trim(delegation_id)<>'') ) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_wait_requests ( tenant_id text NOT NULL, action_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, input_key text NOT NULL, method TEXT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT execution_wait_requests_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,action_id,generation,input_key), CONSTRAINT execution_wait_requests_wait_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,action_id,generation) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_waits(tenant_id,action_id,generation), CONSTRAINT execution_wait_requests_key_ck CHECK (trim(input_key)<>''), CONSTRAINT execution_wait_requests_method_ck CHECK (method IN ('elicitation/create','sampling/createMessage','roots/list')) ) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_events ( tenant_id text NOT NULL, session_id text NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, event_id text NOT NULL, type text NOT NULL, schema_id text NOT NULL, canonical_json text NOT NULL, occurred_second INTEGER NOT NULL, occurred_nano integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT execution_events_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,session_id,event_sequence), CONSTRAINT execution_events_identity_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,session_id,event_id), CONSTRAINT execution_events_run_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,run_id,session_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_runs(tenant_id,run_id,session_id), CONSTRAINT execution_events_content_ck CHECK (event_sequence>0 AND revision>0 AND trim(event_id)<>'' AND trim(type)<>'' AND trim(schema_id)<>'' AND trim(canonical_json)<>'' AND occurred_nano BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999) ) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_execution_supplements ( tenant_id text NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, input_id TEXT NOT NULL, content_ref text NOT NULL, fingerprint text NOT NULL, actor_ref text NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, applied_revision INTEGER, CONSTRAINT execution_supplements_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,run_id,input_id), CONSTRAINT execution_supplements_ordinal_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id,run_id,ordinal), CONSTRAINT execution_supplements_run_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_runs(tenant_id,run_id), CONSTRAINT execution_supplements_content_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,content_ref) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_materials(tenant_id,reference), CONSTRAINT execution_supplements_identity_ck CHECK (trim(input_id)<>'' AND trim(fingerprint)<>'' AND trim(actor_ref)<>''), CONSTRAINT execution_supplements_revision_ck CHECK (ordinal>0 AND (applied_revision IS NULL OR applied_revision>0)) ) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS execution_runs_due_idx ON agent_runtime_execution_runs(tenant_id,next_due_second,next_due_nano,run_id) WHERE phase IN ('READY','AWAITING_RESULT') AND NOT cancelled AND next_due_second IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS execution_runs_session_idx ON agent_runtime_execution_runs(tenant_id,session_id,created_second,created_nano);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_desktop_sessions(id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT NOT NULL,workspace TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_desktop_verified_identities(tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,reference TEXT NOT NULL,session_id TEXT NOT NULL,target_kind TEXT NOT NULL,target_id TEXT NOT NULL,end_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(end_user_id>0),policy_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(policy_revision>0),PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,reference)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_desktop_identity_scopes(tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,reference TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,reference,scope),FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,reference) REFERENCES agent_runtime_desktop_verified_identities(tenant_id,reference)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_desktop_send_authorizations(tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,attempt_id),FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,attempt_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_execution_attempts(tenant_id,attempt_id)) STRICT;
mapper.select: SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,target_kind,target_id,session_id,end_user_id,subject_kind,subject_id FROM agent_runtime_session_owners WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id,subject_kind,subject_id,last_event_sequence FROM agent_runtime_execution_sessions WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,reference,schema_id,canonical_json FROM agent_runtime_execution_materials WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,run_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id,subject_kind,subject_id,agent_id,requester_kind,requester_end_user_id,requester_system_principal_id,source_session_id,source_message_id,origin_ref,input_id,trace_id,span_id,root_input_id,caused_by_event_id,identity_ref,actor_verification_ref,configuration_ref,input_ref,initial_context_ref,admission_fingerprint,status,phase,revision,fence,cancelled,decisions,tool_calls,knowledge_calls,context_ref,current_action_id,waiting_action_id,waiting_generation,batch_source_attempt,batch_size,lease_worker_id,lease_claim_id,lease_until_second,lease_until_nano,next_due_second,next_due_nano,created_second,created_nano,updated_second,updated_nano FROM agent_runtime_execution_runs WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,action_id,run_id,action_ordinal,kind,target_handle,capability_ref,request_ref,fingerprint,status,current_attempt,selected_attempt,batch_source_attempt,batch_size,batch_slot FROM agent_runtime_execution_actions WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,attempt_id,action_id,run_id,fence,request_ref,fingerprint,continuation_generation,result_kind,result_ref,uncertainty_ref,feedback_ref,external_operation,adopted,observation_sequence FROM agent_runtime_execution_attempts WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,run_id,source_attempt,slot,size,action_id,first_attempt_id,reused,reused_result_ref,reused_feedback_ref FROM agent_runtime_execution_batch_members WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,run_id,action_id,generation,kind,source_attempt,input_id,response_ref,fingerprint,actor_ref,accepted_revision,continuation_attempt,consumed_revision,declared_revision,business_wait_id,execution_id,suspend_ref,action_key,execution_revision,plan_id,plan_revision FROM agent_runtime_execution_waits WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,action_id,generation,ordinal,delegation_id,child_run_id FROM agent_runtime_execution_wait_children WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,action_id,generation,input_key,method FROM agent_runtime_execution_wait_requests WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,session_id,run_id,event_sequence,revision,event_id,type,schema_id,canonical_json,occurred_second,occurred_nano FROM agent_runtime_execution_events WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,run_id,input_id,content_ref,fingerprint,actor_ref,ordinal,applied_revision FROM agent_runtime_execution_supplements WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT id,title,workspace,created_at FROM agent_runtime_desktop_sessions WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,reference,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id,policy_revision FROM agent_runtime_desktop_verified_identities WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,reference,scope FROM agent_runtime_desktop_identity_scopes WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,attempt_id FROM agent_runtime_desktop_send_authorizations WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,root_id,scenario,source_version,policy_mode,active_limit_seconds,closing_active_seconds,closing_run_id,phase FROM agent_runtime_budget_roots WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,run_id,root_id,role,source_version,policy_mode,active_limit_seconds FROM agent_runtime_budget_runs WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,scope_kind,scope_id,dimension,policy_mode,maximum,consumed,reserved FROM agent_runtime_budget_balances WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,attempt_id,run_id,fingerprint,category,closing,state,result_reference FROM agent_runtime_budget_attempts WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,attempt_id,result_reference FROM agent_runtime_budget_result_receipts WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,run_id,target_handle FROM agent_runtime_budget_closing_targets WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,attempt_id,dimension,reserved,reported,settled FROM agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts WHERE 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT tenant_id,run_id,interval_id,started_at,confirmed_through FROM agent_runtime_budget_activity WHERE 0)
